name: SD: A support team that learns on the job (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A support team's tickets waiting, tickets answered and awaiting the customer, and the team's experience, counted every day. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-learning-curve/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests an effect shaped like a learning curve: the team answers faster the more experience it has, saturating; experience grows with the work done and fades with forgetting and staff turnover.
